title: FlowCheck: Helping End-Users Specify and Verify Intent in Vibe-Coded Web Apps
abstract: arXiv:2608.28880v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vibe-coded applications often contain silent behavioral failures in which the interface appears functional even though user-visible information does not flow to the expected state or output. We introduce FlowCheck, a constraint language to specify these user-visible information flows directly through the application interface, where constraints can also be displayed and inspected without reading code, and are structured enough for reliable LLM generation. FlowCheck translates the constraints into deterministic CodeQL analyses, and we evaluate it across four applications generated via Claude Code, and compare with three coding models as bug-finding baselines. We find that FlowCheck correctly translates and flags all 30 of our injected constraint violations with no false positives. translated_title: FlowCheck：帮助终端用户在氛围编码的Web应用中指定与验证意图
translated_abstract: 氛围编码（vibe-coded）应用中常常存在静默的行为故障：尽管界面看起来功能正常，但用户可见的信息并未流向预期的状态或输出。我们提出了FlowCheck，这是一种约束语言，可直接通过应用界面来指定这类用户可见的信息流；这些约束无需阅读代码即可被展示和检查，且其结构化程度足以支持可靠的LLM生成。FlowCheck将这些约束转化为确定性的CodeQL分析。我们在四个由Claude Code生成的应用上对其进行了评估，并与三个编码模型作为缺陷检测基线进行比较。结果表明，FlowCheck正确翻译并标记了全部30个注入的约束违规，且无误报。相比之下，前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.7、DeepSeek V3和Gemini Pro）在被提示在相同代码中查找缺陷时，准确率显著更低。
tldr: FlowCheck是一种约束语言，让终端用户无需读代码即可直接在应用界面上指定并检查用户可见的信息流意图，并将其转化为确定性的CodeQL分析，能够全部准确检出30个注入的约束违规且无误报，显著优于前沿大模型直接找bug的表现。
en_tdlr: FlowCheck is a constraint language that lets end-users specify and inspect user-visible information-flow intent directly through the app interface without reading code, translating constraints into deterministic CodeQL analyses that catch all 30 injected constraint violations with zero false positives, substantially outperforming frontier LLMs at bug-finding.
